drawings.kind: stable graphs (MD graphs: weighted vertices, multiple edges, loops, free edges)
drawings.notes: Encoded from tight crops of p. 46 (three stable-graph/1 encodings) and rendered from the data, with the vertex positions, edge curves and free-edge ends read off the page. First graph: seven vertices weighted 0, 13, 4, 2, 0, 3, 1 (as the transcription lists them): a triple edge between the left 0 and 2 (two arcs and a straight stroke), a loop at the left 0 (one side faint), a double edge 13 - 4, single edges 13 - 2, 4 - 2, 4 - 0, 2 - 0 (right), 2 - 1, 0 (right) - 3; free edges: two at the left 0 (one faint), three at 4, one at the right 0. Derived: b1 = 6, so by his genus formula of p. 48 (g = sum of the weights + rank H^1) the type is (g, nu) = (29, 6); every vertex is stable (2g - 2 + n > 0). Below, under "2°" (the transcription's reading; the earlier "2 deg" reading is dropped): a vertex 0 with three free edges (one short, one long and faint, one curved), type (0, 3); and a vertex 3 with a loop, type (4, 0). The faint strokes are drawn like the others: they leave the vertices like the inked ones and nothing marks them as struck. The first pass missed the third A-B edge and the vertex 3 (at the end of the edge from the right 0).

drawings.kind: stable graph with isolated vertices (MD graph with only free edges)

Derived: five components, b1 = 0, nu = 8 free edges; the genus of each component is its weight (his formula g = sum g_s + rank H^1 with H^1 = 0). Stability is not claimed on the page and depends on the genera (g_1, g_2 bare: stable only for genus >= 2; g_4 with one leg: genus >= 1); the checker's valence test reports it false. The label read g_2 by the transcription looks like "g" followed by a tilde-like stroke on the facsimile; the reading g_2 is kept.
